name: Randall Hall
use: Traditional residence hall in the Upper Quad (525 students across Hitchcock, Randall and Devine)
architect: Irving W. Hersey Associates (builder Blanchard Stebbins, Inc.)

facts.text: Built with Hitchcock Hall by Irving W. Hersey Associates and Blanchard Stebbins; construction ran from 1958 to August 1959 and it was dedicated April 24, 1960 to trustee Frank W. Randall (class of 1907).
Four floors in the middle of the Upper Quad; a first-floor lounge and a large second-floor study lounge with full kitchen and fireplace. Address 7 Quad Way.
Part of the linked Upper Quad with Hitchcock, Randall and Devine (525 students in all), with an elevator, kitchen, laundry and indoor bike storage; no air conditioning is listed.

s19a.title: Ranking of UNH Dorms and Residence Halls

verdict: The middle hall of the 1959 Upper Quad: plain brick, a good study lounge, no A/C.
notes: No licensed photo of Randall specifically; Hitchcock 02 (Commons) may show part of the linked Upper Quad, but I could not tell which wing. The archives reference photo is a wide, low-resolution view of a long brick block. No renovation found.
